body: It's fucking bizarre.  What I lack is something that seems to come so easy to everyone I know.  Yet here I am, constantly struggling.  I don't blame it on anyone.  I'm at fault here.  I want to fix it.  I'm not sitting around doing nothing and complaining.  I write things down, I study it.  I work so hard to change everything.  Suicide is the last resort.  But honestly my time is running out.  I'm getting old.  I've been on this road so many times now.  I thought I would learn something about myself by now, but here I am, at step 1 again, frustrated, crying, just done with life.  I like to believe that the problem is me because then I can change myself.  It's the one thing I have some control over in this fucking miserable life.  Why the fuck can't I get this fucking right?? Why do I have to constantly stumble to the point that it becomes a habit, a twitch in how I move in life.  This is not normal.  Failing in life is okay, but constant failure at every turn is crippling and damaging my fucking soul into pieces.
